projects.name: KernelOwl / KerSor / AKW

projects.name: EngineTailor

projects.name: ApxInf

projects.name: KernelOwl / KerSor / AKW
bullets: Built a ReAct runtime across CLI, TUI, and SDK, with MCP extensions, task graphs, sessions, traces, and context management.
Designed typed task handoffs and host-side verification for Codex and Claude Code, with rollback and verified-best version tracking.

projects.name: GPU Infra / Agent GPU Broker
bullets: Built immutable candidate submission, shared/exclusive GPU scheduling, and atomic multi-GPU allocation across compilation, correctness, sanitizers, and timing.
Validated on A800/B200; used SIGKILL fault injection on A800 to check process, container, and GPU cleanup while retaining interruption records.

projects.name: Cake IR / open-cake-ir
bullets: Designed a Python DSL and typed schedule/program IR for tiling, memory, and synchronization, with Triton, CUDA, CuTe DSL, and Metal code generation.

projects.name: EngineTailor
bullets: Designed Manager/Worker/Supervisor collaboration and worktree isolation, separating candidate generation from acceptance and verification.
Optimized graph boundaries for Qwen3-4B on B200 at concurrency 16; output throughput rose from 3078.6 to 4654.8 tokens/s, a 51.2% gain within the same engine.
